invalid_if: The Company is made liable for the Investor's costs whether or not the Investment completes
name: Confidentiality and Costs
title: Confidentiality and Costs
text:
This provision is a Binding Provision.
(a) Each Party shall keep confidential the existence and the terms of this Term Sheet and all information it receives from another Party in connection with the Investment, and shall not disclose them except to its professional advisers who are bound by a duty of confidence, or as required by law or by a regulator.
(b) Each Party shall bear its own costs of negotiating and documenting the Investment, whether or not the Investment proceeds. The Company shall bear costs of the Investor only if, and to the extent that, the Definitive Agreements so provide.

legal_basis.note: Compensation for loss caused by breach
Perpetual injunction to prevent breach of an obligation

authoring_note: Costs are drafted to protect the Company: a start-up should not pay an investor's costs for a deal that does not complete.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
